name: brain-dump
description: Turns long voice-dictated prompts into a clear, structured prompt before Claude sees them, with sections that fit the intent (bug, feature, change, question, review, workflow), or into a Gauntlet Loop prompt

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: confirm: ask before rewriting a long prompt. auto: rewrite without asking. off: never rewrite (the force prefix still works).

minWords.title: Minimum words
minWords.description: A prompt with at least this many words counts as a brain dump.

forcePrefix.title: Force prefix
forcePrefix.description: A prompt starting or ending with this word is always rewritten, whatever its length or the mode. The word is removed. Saying "this is a brain dump" at the start of a sentence does the same. Empty: none.

gauntletPrefix.title: Gauntlet loop prefix
gauntletPrefix.description: A prompt starting or ending with this word becomes a Gauntlet Loop prompt: a builder and a harsh critic loop until the work beats a named reference. Saying "make a gauntlet loop" does the same. The word is removed. Empty: only the phrase.

skipPrefix.title: Skip prefix
skipPrefix.description: A prompt starting with this word is never rewritten. The prefix is removed. Empty: none.

askQuestions.title: Ask clarifying questions
askQuestions.description: Before rewriting, ask about gaps: required sections you did not cover, and points that are unclear or contradictory. Each question offers 'Let the agent decide'.

maxQuestions.title: Max questions
maxQuestions.description: The most questions to ask in one round.

requiredSections.title: Required sections (no intent)
requiredSections.description: Comma-separated sections a prompt must have when it fits no intent (bug, feature, change, question, review each have their own). A section your brain dump does not cover becomes a question, never a guess. Known: Task, Why, Scope, Requirements and guardrails, Done when.

maxRounds.title: Question rounds
maxRounds.description: How many times the rewrite is checked for gaps and you are asked again before it goes to the prompt box.

useConversation.title: Use the conversation
useConversation.description: Find gaps with a fork of this conversation, so references like 'that file' are resolved and already-settled points are not asked again. Off: the brain dump alone is read.

review.title: Review before sending
review.description: On: the rewrite goes into the prompt box for you to edit and send. Off: the rewrite is sent at once.

keepHistory.title: Keep history
keepHistory.description: Keep a local log of each brain dump, the answers and the rewrite in ~/.claude/brain-dump/history.jsonl, to review later. Off: nothing is written.

model.title: Model
model.description: The model that asks the questions and writes the rewrite (alias or full id).
